content.text: The Mistake Almost Every Creator Makes First

The most common mistake creators make is relying on payment platforms that are not designed for their region or are restricted in their country. For instance, using a platform that does not support the local currency or has high transaction fees can lead to lost sales and revenue. Moreover, these platforms often have strict requirements and may suspend accounts without notice, causing creators to lose access to their earnings. Creators in Africa and Southeast Asia are particularly vulnerable to these issues due to the limited availability of payment options.
Why This Keeps Happening Even to Experienced Sellers

Experienced sellers are not immune to these issues, as they often underestimate the importance of having a sovereign digital commerce stack. They may have successfully sold digital products in the past using restricted platforms, but this does not guarantee future success. The ever-changing landscape of payment regulations and platform restrictions means that creators must be proactive in seeking out alternative solutions.
